technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with golden cross and new highs, but multiple overbought oscillators and ichimoku cloud positioning create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with elevated caution.

fundamental.summary: PM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 15 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear signal; fear sentiment (37) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of senior conviction buying and unavailable news sentiment limit bullish conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (390), flat yield curve, and earnings in 15 days create a highly unfavourable risk environment for PM despite neutral dollar conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with new 20-day highs and CMF cross-up confirm uptrend structure with technical momentum, supported by fear-zone sentiment offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought oscillators (RSI 78/73, Stoch 88), ichimoku below cloud, crisis VIX, high earnings risk in 15 days, zero fundamental/smart money support, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create compounding pullback and gap-down risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical uptrend structure (golden cross, new highs, CMF cross) offers momentum entry, but overbought oscillators and price below key moving averages create immediate pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 15 days combined with crisis VIX and multiple overbought conditions create high probability of gap-down reversal before fundamental catalyst.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding PM with 30 existing Consumer Staples positions (9% sector concentration); skip to avoid compounding sector and ticker concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment.
